parts.key_points_summary: This module covers fundamental economic theories including microeconometric time series regression, macroeconomic supply and demand, GDP and GDP per capita, and introduces the concept of digital infrastructure as public goods.
learning_objectives: Grasp macroeconomic concepts like GDP and supply-demand.
Define and analyze the digital economy.
parts.title: Foundations of Economic Analysis

parts.key_points_summary: Exploration of microeconometric techniques (time series, regression) applied to the digital economy. Focus on supply, demand, GDP, GDP per capita within the context of digital infrastructure and public goods.
learning_objectives: Apply microeconomic models to digital markets.
Assess the impact of network effects.
parts.title: Microeconomic Principles in the Digital Sphere

parts.key_points_summary: In this part we are going to evaluate microeconometrics, macro and digital economy.
learning_objectives: Interpret macroeconomic data in a digital context.
Evaluate the influence of technology on GDP.
parts.title: Macroeconomic Indicators and the Digital Economy

parts.key_points_summary: Analysis on Microeconometrics, Macroeconomics and Digital Economy.
learning_objectives: Explain the importance of digital infrastructure.
Analyze the provision of digital public goods.
parts.title: Digital Infrastructure and Public Goods

parts.key_points_summary: This will focus on Microeconometrics, Macroeconomics and Digital Economy.
learning_objectives: Assess the role of innovation in digital growth.
Examine the impact of digital technologies on labor markets.
Consider the future of the digital economy.
parts.title: Digital Transformation and Economic Growth
